# forgejo_user (Resource)

Use this resource to create and manage a user. The provider must be configured with the credentials of an administrator to use this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "forgejo_user" "main" {
  email    = "test@example.com"
  login    = "test"
  password = "secure password"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) The user's email address.
- `login` (String) The login (username) of the user.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the user is active or not. If unset, the server value will be left as is.
- `description` (String) A description string. If unset, the server value will be left as is.
- `full_name` (String) The user's full name. If unset, the server value will be left as is.
- `is_admin` (Boolean) Whether the user is an admin or not. If unset, the server value will be left as is.
- `location` (String) The user's advertised location. If unset, the server value will be left as is.
- `login_name` (String) The user's authentication sign-in name, used with external authentication sources. Defaults to the user's login.
- `must_change_password` (Boolean) Whether the user must change their password on next sign-in. If unset, the server value will be left as is. This value cannot be read back from forgejo: changes made outside of terraform will not be detected.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) The user's password. Required when `source_id` is `0` (local authentication). This value cannot be read back from forgejo: changes made outside of terraform will not be detected.
- `prohibit_login` (Boolean) Whether the user is prohibited from signing in or not. If unset, the server value will be left as is.
- `pronouns` (String) The user's advertised pronouns. If unset, the server value will be left as is.
- `restricted` (Boolean) Whether the user is restricted or not. If unset, the server value will be left as is.
- `source_id` (Number) The identifier of the user's authentication source, `0` being local authentication. If unset, the server value will be left as is.
- `visibility` (String) The user's visibility option: `limited`, `private`, `public`. If unset, the server value will be left as is.
- `website` (String) The user's advertised website. If unset, the server value will be left as is.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) The user's creation date and time.
- `html_url` (String) The URL to this user's Forgejo profile page.
- `id` (Number) The identifier of the user.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import forgejo_user.main <username>
```
